primary_task: Rewrite or create an agent/system prompt, with a contract, small eval set, and optimization log.

requirements.name: read files (references/*.md, repo context)
requirements.basis: read: read files in the working directory; search them by name pattern or content (glob, grep)

requirements.name: running prompts on an eval set
requirements.evidence: "Baseline the current prompt on the same eval slice"
requirements.basis: agent: start sub-agents that work in parallel, send them messages and list them

notes: No external model API is named; porting to OpenAI or Gemini is textual only. If evals had to be run on other vendors' models, credentials would be unavailable.
